standard_prerequisites.name: The reduced induced subspace structure on a closed subset
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Properties of Spaces, definition spaces-properties-definition-reduced-induced-space (invoked at proof lines 3080-3081)
standard_prerequisites.use: It endows $Z_0$ and $Z_1$ with the reduced structure so that the inclusions $i_0$ and $i_1$ are closed immersions of algebraic spaces.

standard_prerequisites.name: Vanishing of $H^1$ on the kernel of the comparison map in the vanishing situation
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter spaces-cohomology.tex, Situation \ref{situation-vanishing} and the vanishing of $H^1$ for quasi-coherent modules there (used at proof line 3090)
standard_prerequisites.use: It makes the map on global sections induced by a surjection of quasi-coherent modules surjective, which is what produces the element $a \in A$.

core_obligations: Endow the two disjoint closed subsets with the reduced induced subspace structure and denote the corresponding closed immersions by $i_0$ and $i_1$ (proof lines 3079-3082).

Show that the canonical map $\mathcal{O}_X \to i_{0,*}\mathcal{O}_{Z_0} \oplus i_{1,*}\mathcal{O}_{Z_1}$ is surjective, by inspecting stalks at geometric points, where the disjointness of $Z_0$ and $Z_1$ rules out any obstruction (proof lines 3083-3089).

Apply the vanishing of $H^1$ to the kernel to conclude that the induced map on global sections is surjective, and choose $a \in A$ mapping to the global section $(0, 1)$; then $Z_0 \subset V(a)$ and $Z_1 \subset V(a - 1)$ (proof lines 3090-3093).
proof_roadmap: Reduced structures and closed immersions (proof lines 3079-3082).
Surjectivity of the comparison map by a stalk computation (proof lines 3083-3089).
Lifting the section $(0,1)$ to a global function $a$ (proof lines 3090-3093).
difficulty_reason: The lemma produces a global function separating two disjoint closed subsets inside the vanishing situation: it takes the value zero on one and the value one on the other (statement lines 3071-3076). The proof endows the subsets with their reduced structures, checks surjectivity of the comparison map to the direct sum of the two structure sheaves at geometric stalks, and uses the vanishing of $H^1$ on the kernel to lift the global section $(0,1)$ to the ring. The surjectivity check and the lifting are the substance, so the claim is H2.
